en: Black‑and‑white image showing a stark, monumental modernist building with strong vertical lines. The foreground has a lower wing with rectangular windows and pilasters around a paved courtyard with small shrubs, while the background is dominated by a very tall, flat facade with long vertical recesses, giving an austere institutional or governmental appearance. No visible caption or text appears on the image side.
